name: Tsuki to Taiyou no Raksharuki
original_name: 月と太陽のラクシャルキ
source:
In this Desert world death threatens all living beings. Main character is a trader who with brothers surfs between different nations selling goods. One day brother gets into an incident during the banquet, and king orders protagonist to retrieve a certain magical lamp within a year to save brother from punishment.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
這是一個沙漠世界，死亡威脅所有生物。主角是與兄弟在各國之間往來、販賣貨物的商人。某天，兄弟在宴會上惹出事件，國王命令主角在一年內取回一盞魔法燈，以免兄弟受罰。

［譯自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]］
